metadata.scope: Introduce AdminFetchError (extends Error) in apps/web/src/lib/admin/server-fetch.ts exposing status/path/responseBodySnippet structured fields, while keeping the current Error.message format (including the ' body=' suffix asserted by existing tests) byte-identical. Make the common lib/server-fetch/safe-fetch.ts prefer the structured status field with a regex fallback. No apps/api change, no D1 change, no Google Form change.
metadata.runtime_boundary: Local implementation, focused Vitest, typecheck, and lint are complete. Staging/runtime observation, commit, push, and PR remain user-gated.
metadata.issue_optimization_note: Issue #991 / followup-001 spec states the target message format as 'admin api ${path} failed: ${status}' (no body) and warns about double-read via Response.clone(). Both are STALE versus current code: server-fetch.ts:530 currently throws 'admin api ${path} failed: ${status}${bodySnippet}' where bodySnippet=' body=${text.slice(0,256)}', and server-fetch.binding.spec.ts:89/101 assert that ' body=' suffix. The body is already read once in the error path (line 512), so Response.clone() is unnecessary. This spec re-optimizes the issue to current code: message stays byte-identical (256-char body= suffix preserved), responseBodySnippet field uses <=500 chars, and the already-read text is reused (no double-read).
